fig_telecom_delay: Mean ping delay per routing mode on cells 7511 and 8336 (bars: mean of the runs; whiskers: min to max; n: runs used). Oracle and alt are hatched reference modes. Each label also gives the share of steps on which that mode wrote a value above 100.
fig_telecom_flips: Route flips (path changes logged by the POX controller) per run, for each routing mode on cells 7511 and 8336.
fig_route_timeline: Cell 7511, run 1: true load and the value the reactive and model modes wrote at each 5 s step. The controller sends traffic on the alternate path while the written value is above 100 (shaded).
fig_accuracy_overall: Mean absolute error of the 6-step forecasts on the synthetic and telecom test blocks, for the federated model, repeat-last and a 3-value moving average.
fig_accuracy_by_cell: Mean absolute error per Milan cell on the telecom test block, federated model next to repeat-last.
fig_training_loss: Training loss after each federated round (aggregated over clients by the Flower server, measured on training examples). It shows that training ran and converged; it is not a measure of forecast quality.
fig_pipeline: FedFlow-LLM pipeline: traffic windows train a federated LoRA model on 6 clients; its forecast is written to a file that the POX controller polls to choose a path in the Mininet network.
fig_topology: Emulated topology: h1 on s1, h2 on s2; primary path s1-s3-s2 at 10 Mbps and alternate path s1-s4-s2 at 50 Mbps.
